target.statement: GER achieves Recall@64 of 85.65 on the ZESHEL test set, outperforming BLINK's 83.98.

compute.basis: Training GER on ZESHEL requires 5 epochs on 4 A100 GPUs (0.8h total), which is infeasible on a CPU-only laptop; even with a single mid-range GPU, training would take several hours, plus data preprocessing and evaluation.

blockers: No code or model weights released
Requires GPU for training (4 A100s used in paper)
Complex pipeline: SPO triplet extraction, hierarchical graph construction, HGAN implementation
title: Modeling Fine-grained Information via Knowledge-aware Hierarchical Graph for Zero-shot Entity Retrieval
